_about: 0.2.8 (5 Nov 2026, Unreleased): two option rows after text_size, CONTROLLER > MENUS AND PROMPTS: Steam Deck mode (deck_mode, automatic at exactly 1280x800) and Larger window text (window_text). docs/UI_SPEC.json and core/ui_meta.h already carry them; this patch brings them to part2_data.js and to the artifact's ui/spec.

rows.label: Steam Deck mode
rows.help: Steam Deck mode: larger text and no safe margins at the screen's edge. Automatic turns it on at exactly 1280x800.

rows.label: Larger window text
rows.help: HUD 2: the text in the game's windows takes the room it has. Prices and other numbers that decide a deal grow most, labels less, headings and buttons not at all.
